scope: Independent local source and test review; no browser runs, live calls, deployment or native acceptance.

acceptedResponsibilities.reason: One existing canonical export form owns input state and a bounded read-pagination-to-CSV workflow. Pending controls, synchronous attempt identity, dependency retirement and cancellation govern the same operation. Canonical API still owns request/receipt validation and authentication; no parallel transport, schema or authority implementation.

One export attempt captures render inputs, carries cursor/revision through at most 100 canonical page reads, and checks abort plus exact attempt identity after each await and immediately before CSV output. Identity-gated error/finally cannot clear or report into a reopened newer attempt. Existing CSV escaping, Blob download and URL disposal are preserved.

One real CSV pagination/download control uses shared setup and asserts exact requests, native duplicate admission, escaped complete readback and filename. These assertions qualify one export result; separate helpers already own setup and burst. No unrelated workflow or mandatory arbitrary split.

sourceFindings: Synchronous active ref admits only one native resubmission before React busy rendering.
Cancel, Escape and close abort the owned request; api/open/week/userId/timeAdmin changes retire it in layout cleanup. Existing scoped API lifetime remains in force.
All editable native export inputs freeze while pending. Cancel remains an explicit read cancellation.
Only current nonaborted attempt may append returned pages, emit download, close or report errors; stale cleanup cannot release newer pending state.
Only the two requested source/test paths changed at worker commit; successor adds only two exact review records.

coverage: Native triple requestSubmit yields one initial request; exact personal/date queries and cursor/revision second page; actual complete escaped CSV and exact filename.
Three independent dismissal cases: Cancel/Escape/Close; actual request abortion, old settlement awaited, no old download and newer attempt remains disabled until its real download.
503 error visible, fields enabled and explicit successful retry yields real CSV.
Week replacement aborts held export and admits no CSV after settlement.
testAssessment.execution: Worker six-pass evidence reported by parent, not independently rerun; root final154 combined and aggregate/build/standalone qualification pending.

limits: Unchanged export date draft state persists when week changes; the fix retires in-flight output rather than silently replacing user-selected dates.
Existing canonical owner is responsible for pagination revision consistency and authorization; no backend/native service proof was performed.
All337 native rows remain open; operational Objective mapping and deferred mobile parity remain outside this repair.
No Meri runtime, shipping gateway/origin/Docker/config or portability changes.
